mentions.name: AutoFlow
mentions.description: Chrome extension that records you using your app and automatically generates user guides that can be published instantly to a user-facing product knowledge base. Offers a free trial.
mentions.problem: Setting up and maintaining a full set of user guides for a SaaS product was challenging at the author's last job.
mentions.audience: SaaS founders, product managers, developers, indiehackers, etc.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on AutoFlow - a chrome extension that lets you record yourself using your app and then automatically generates user guides that you can publish instantly to a user-facing product knowledge base.
